about.name: Colin Clark
about.title: Cybersecurity GRC & Computer Science
about.bio: I’m a Boston College computer science student graduating in May 2027. At the Medical University of South Carolina, I worked on vendor and internal technology risk assessments. At Janos LLC, I research cybersecurity and AI policy, including EU AI Act compliance. I previously built data and AI prototypes at Allegis Group and teach Python and Java as a computer science TA at Boston College.

projects.title: Hospital Cybersecurity & HIPAA Awareness
projects.shortDescription: Designed a HIPAA and phishing awareness campaign.
projects.fullDescription: For my Boston College capstone, I designed a HIPAA compliance and phishing-prevention campaign for a simulated 400-bed hospital. I defined reporting metrics and built a click-tracking website to measure phishing resilience across repeated tests.
projects.technologies: HIPAA awareness, phishing prevention, reporting metrics

projects.title: CyberSlayers
projects.shortDescription: Built a game-based cybersecurity learning platform.
projects.fullDescription: I led development of an interactive cybersecurity education platform in React. It uses narrative dialogue and multi-stage quizzes to teach phishing detection, digital footprint awareness, and public network safety. I worked on narrative design, sprite integration, client-side game logic, and the content structure.

projects.title: LLM Chimera
projects.shortDescription: Built a Python pipeline that coordinates four model APIs.
projects.fullDescription: I built a Python pipeline that assigns models roles such as manager, researcher, and validator. I wrote reusable prompts for each role and used cross-model critique and structured scoring to reduce hallucinations and the need for manual oversight between iterations.
projects.technologies: Python, Google Colab, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Grok APIs

projects.title: Santa Barbara Restaurant Recommender
projects.shortDescription: Built and evaluated nine Yelp recommendation models.
projects.fullDescription: For Boston College coursework, I built and evaluated nine recommendation models using Yelp data. The models included content-based recommenders, a TF-IDF ridge regression rating predictor, and an SVD collaborative filter. I engineered 57 restaurant features and compared the models using precision, recall, NDCG, and hit rate at 10, 20, and 30 recommendations.
projects.technologies: Python, Google Colab, TF-IDF, ridge regression, SVD

projects.title: Password Manager
projects.shortDescription: Built a Java password manager with local encryption.
projects.fullDescription: I developed a password manager with templates for account credentials and customizable entries. The application stores data locally using AES-256 through the Java Cryptography Extension.

experience.title: Research Intern & Published Author
details: Research and write about cybersecurity and AI policy for U.S. Cybersecurity Magazine with Dr. Diane Janosek, including analysis of EU AI Act compliance requirements.
Supported expert interviews on the U.S. Department of Defense’s migration to post-quantum cryptography and on cybercrime.

experience.title: Governance, Risk & Compliance and BC/DR Intern
details: Managed third-party vendor and internal technology risk assessments in ServiceNow, aligned with HIPAA, FDA, NIST, and ISO 27001/27002 requirements and guidance. Used BitSight to scope vendor exposure.

Tracked assessments, escalated blockers, resolved support tickets, and migrated assessment templates from test to production. Participated in business continuity and disaster recovery tabletop exercises.

experience.title: Data Analyst & AI Intern
details: Built data and AI proofs of concept using Salesforce, Snowflake, JupyterLab, and Google Cloud Platform. Wrote technical documentation and handoff guides for internal teams.

Led delivery of Astro, the company’s first agentic AI product, from requirements to deployment in six weeks. The Salesforce-integrated chatbot included workflow integration, legal guardrails, documentation, and demos.
Built an internal AI-content detection tool that improved accuracy by 67% using character-level feature analysis, Jaccard similarity, and weighted scoring.

experience.title: Teaching Assistant, Computer Science I & II
details: Mentor students individually and in groups on programming fundamentals, debugging, and coding practices in Python and Java.
